subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking from New York to London on July 15th has been successfully confirmed. Please find the attached e-ticket for your reference. Kindly arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure for check-in procedures. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Airlines Team
